A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] '''individual''' was the manager of [[Colliders Casino]] on the planet [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] traveled to Lianna, hunting a a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Unidentified Shi'ido|Shi'ido]] who had been [[Telekinesis/Legends|using]] the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and his [[Changeling/Legends|skinshifting]] abilities to cheat at Colliders, the Casino's namesake game, as part of Plagueis' mission to eliminate potential rivals. The manager aided Plagueis in identifying his target.
